title: CLI and Utility Scripts
summary: This module provides the command-line interface (CLI) entry point for the `clai` tool, along with various utility scripts for testing, maintenance, and cloud service verification. It includes tools for checking VCR cassettes, uploading test files to cloud providers, and verifying Vertex AI's integration with Google Cloud Storage.

nodes.label: Run CLI Command
nodes.title: CLI Entry Point
nodes.description: Provides the main entry point for the `clai` command-line interface, executing the core CLI logic and exiting.

nodes.label: Test & Update README Help
nodes.title: CLI Help Test and README Update
nodes.description: Verifies `clai --help` output against `README.md` and updates it if needed, failing the test on update.

nodes.label: Check VCR Cassettes
nodes.title: Orphaned VCR Cassette Checker
nodes.description: Scans for VCR cassettes and matching tests, reporting 'orphaned' cassettes that lack corresponding tests.

nodes.label: Upload Test Files to Cloud
nodes.title: Cloud Test File Uploader
nodes.description: Uploads test files to various cloud providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) for testing purposes.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex AI GCS
nodes.title: Vertex AI GCS Verification
nodes.description: Verifies Vertex AI functionality with Google Cloud Storage (GCS) URIs for different file types.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex AI GCS All Types
nodes.title: Vertex AI GCS All Types Verification
nodes.description: Extends GCS verification to cover all supported file types with Vertex AI, ensuring broad compatibility.

nodes.label: Test Vertex AI GCS Tool Result
nodes.title: Vertex AI GCS Tool Result Test
nodes.description: Tests Vertex AI's handling of GCS URIs within tool results, both embedded and as separate file data parts.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.title: README Documentation
nodes.description: The project's main documentation file, which is updated by CLI help tests.

nodes.title: VCR Test Recordings
nodes.description: Files containing recorded HTTP interactions used for VCR-based tests.

nodes.label: Cloud Providers

nodes.title: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
nodes.description: Google's scalable object storage service, used for storing and accessing test files.
